summary: Vera Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to disclose alignment with the FDA on a revised eGFR analysis plan for atacicept in IgA Nephropathy, with results expected in Q3 2026 and a supplemental BLA submission planned for Q4 2026. This is a regulatory update on an existing drug development program, not a special situation. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisors, or mechanics are involved. The filing is routine and forward-looking; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. What to watch: upcoming eGFR data and FDA approval timeline.
